headlines.title: Person dies following crash that left another seriously hurt in San Jose
headlines.description: A person died and another person sustained major injuries following a crash in San Jose on Sunday, the police department said. Officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on Tully Road and Glen Angus Way around 5:44 p.m., according to authorities. One person was pronounced dead at the scene while the other sustained major injuries and was taken to a local hospital, the department said. The San Jose Fire Department later clarified the person who died was the passenger in one of the vehicles, while the driver was taken to the hospital with life-threatening injuries. The department added three people in the second vehicle involved were transported with non-life-threatening injuries. The police department said southbound South White Road is closed between Cunningham Avenue and Tully Road, with northbound lanes expected to reopen shortly. Authorities stated Tully Road remains closed in both directions between South White Road and East Capitol Expressway until further notice.
